articles.title: Sairé em Alter do Chão: Busca dos Mastros inicia festejos | G1
articles.standfirst: Cortejo fluvial partiu da Praia das Mangueiras em direção à Praia da Arioca neste sábado (12). Programação reuniu comunidade, integrantes da corte e visitantes na vila balneária.
articles.summary: A Busca dos Mastros reuniu devotos e turistas em um cortejo fluvial pelo Rio Tapajós, iniciando oficialmente as celebrações do Sairé 2026 em Alter do Chão.
articles.body:
Mastros em Alter do Chão — Foto: Dominique Cavaleiro/g1

O Rito Tradicional do Sairé ganhou as águas do Rio Tapajós na manhã deste sábado (12) com a realização da histórica Busca dos Mastros, em Alter do Chão, em Santarém, no oeste do Pará. O evento, que marca o início oficial dos festejos que antecedem a celebração principal e o Festival dos Botos, reuniu a Corte do Sairé, moradores, devotos e turistas.

​A programação começou às 7h no Barracão do Sairé com um café da manhã comunitário. Em seguida, os participantes embarcaram em um cortejo fluvial que partiu da Praia das Mangueiras em direção à Praia da Arioca, onde os mastros de cururu e jacitara foram retirados da mata e preparados conforme a tradição ancestral.

Corte da Festa do Sairé 2026 — Foto: Dominique Cavaleiro/g1

Para as lideranças tradicionais da vila balneária, o momento simboliza a manutenção de uma herança de resistência e fé que atravessa séculos no Baixo Tapajós. Juiz da corte do Sairé, o Cacique Maduro enfatizou a dimensão espiritual e a responsabilidade de repassar o rito aos mais jovens.

​"Este é um dos momentos mais importantes do Sairé. A Busca dos Mastros não é apenas uma festa, é a nossa identidade, a nossa raiz. É uma tradição que precisamos cuidar e ensinar todos os dias para que passe para as próximas gerações e nunca se apague", ressaltou o Cacique Maduro.

​Após a travessia e o retorno do cortejo à vila, as atividades prosseguiram com almoço comunitário, ladainhas e a apresentação do tradicional grupo Espantacão.

​Presente na abertura da programação cultural e religiosa, o prefeito de Santarém, José Maria Tapajós, destacou a estrutura montada e a importância do evento para a economia e a visibilidade internacional do município.

​"Estamos trabalhando integrados para realizar o melhor Sairé de todos os tempos. A Busca dos Mastros abre com chave de ouro essa festividade que orgulha Santarém, movimenta o nosso turismo, gera renda e mostra para o mundo a riqueza da cultura amazônica", afirmou o gestor municipal.

​A festividade segue ao longo da noite a partir das 19h30, na Praça do Sairé, com a Festa dos Mastros no Palco Ludimar Lobato, trazendo atrações musicais regionais como Lobatinho, Banda 5ª Dimensão, Izellon e Banda.

articles.title: Picolé de costelinha, pastel de frango com quiabo, 'uaikisoba': festival usa a criatividade na comida mineira em Pouso Alegre | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento une gastronomia e shows musicais. Sebrae tem programação de cozinhas-show com receitas feitas por chefs da região.
articles.summary: Evento une gastronomia e shows musicais. Sebrae tem programação de cozinhas-show com receitas feitas por chefs da região.
articles.body:
A comida mineira é a estrela do Festival Gastronômico e Cultural que ocorre em Pouso Alegre (MG) até domingo (13).

Na programação, diversos pratos de diversas origens, mas todos adaptados para o "gostinho mineiro" com muita criatividade, como o picolé de costelinha, o pastel de frango com quiabo e ainda o "uaikisoba" de frango.

Há ainda outras opções como: joelho de porco defumado; tarteletes, bolos e brigadeiros; pastéis de carne, queijo; tropeiro, torresmo e batata chips; poke de salmão; hambúrgueres; saladas, verrines, café especial, sucos naturais e geleias; bolinhos; pão de queijo com geleias; além de Trio da Toca e arroz de costela.

Festival gastronômico em Pouso Alegre tem picolé de costelinha entre as opções — Foto: Sebrae Minas/Divulgação

Os participantes do Festival são empreendedores que passaram por uma consultoria voltada à elaboração de pratos para festivais gastronômicos, realizada pelo Sebrae Minas em parceria com o Sindicato de Hotéis, Restaurantes, Bares e Similares (SINDIPA).

Durante todo o evento, haverá apresentações de talentos locais:

🎤Sábado (12/9) 13h - Yasmin Siebra 15h - Banda Nohau 18h - Rustyca 20h - Trio Scuba 🎶 Domingo (13/09) 13h - Bia 15h - Lê Guimarães 18h - Samba Brazucas

Pastel de frango com quiabo é uma das opções do Festival Gastronômico de Pouso Alegre — Foto: Sebrae/Divulgação

Entre as atrações do festival, haverá apresentações de cozinha-show com chefs da região, que vão preparar receitas e compartilhar técnicas e experiências com o público.

👩‍🍳👨‍🍳 Veja a programação da cozinha-show:

Sábado (12/9) 🌾🌾 14h - Arroz caldoso da Serra da Mantiqueira com a chef Josélia Lemes 🌾🍷 16h - Risoto camponesa com vinho Alma Mineira com a chef Sônia Kohen 🐖☕ 17h30 - Tortelete de ragu de costelinha e barbecue de café especial com os chefs Ricardo Martin e Sônia Lauria

Domingo (13/9) 🧀🍯 14h - Risoto de queijo com mel com a chef Lilian Freitas 🍸🍹16h - Drinks clássicos e contemporâneos com cachaça com chef Léo Gomes 🥔🧀 18h - Nhoque de mandioquinha na fonduta de parmesão com a chef Caroline Bitencourt

Festival Gastronômico e Cultural de Pouso Alegre 🗓️ Até 13 de setembro (domingo) 🕐 A partir das 12h 📍 Via Gastronômica de Pouso Alegre 🎟️ Entrada gratuita

articles.title: Sarau Cultural Iurupari em Santarém: Ufopa tem evento gratuito | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento acontece neste sábado (12) na Unidade Rondon e terá 13 apresentações artísticas; entrada é franca.
articles.summary: O Sarau Cultural Iurupari oferece 13 apresentações gratuitas de música, dança e teatro na Unidade Rondon da Ufopa, em Santarém, neste sábado (12).
articles.body:
Elenco do grupo Teatro Iurupari em cena durante o espetáculo "O Mocó", no encerramento do IV Festival Solos do Pará — Foto: Divulgação

A Universidade Federal do Oeste do Pará (Ufopa), em Santarém , recebe neste sábado (12) a 5ª edição do Sarau Cultural Iurupari. O evento gratuito reúne apresentações de música, dança, teatro e artes plásticas na área externa do Espaço de Formação Cultural, a partir das 19h.

Organizado pelo Teatro Iurupari e pelo Instituto de Ciências da Educação (Iced), em parceria com a Pró-Reitoria de Cultura, Comunidade e Extensão (Procce), o sarau busca incentivar e valorizar a produção artística local.

Para esta edição, foram selecionadas 13 atrações de diferentes segmentos. O público poderá acompanhar:

3 exposições de artes plásticas e visuais;

1 performance que mistura dança, voz e instrumentos.

Onde: Área externa do Espaço de Formação Cultural da Ufopa (Unidade Rondon – Av. Marechal Rondon, s/n, bairro Caranazal)

articles.title: A um mês do Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, número de fiéis começa a aumentar no Santuário Nacional | G1
articles.standfirst: Visitantes de diferentes partes do país começam a chegar à cidade; veja a programação da Festa da Padroeira
articles.summary: Visitantes de diferentes partes do país começam a chegar à cidade; veja a programação da Festa da Padroeira
articles.body:
A um mês para o Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida , celebrado em 12 de outubro, fiéis já começaram a chegar à cidade para a Festa da Padroeira do Brasil .

Mesmo com chuva, o movimento de peregrinos já pode ser observado pelas ruas do centro de Aparecida. A expectativa é de que a quantidade de visitantes aumente nas próximas semanas, com a proximidade da data .

A enfermeira Débora Rezende veio de Ibiá, em Minas Gerais. Ela diz que nem o mau tempo tem atrapalhado a temporada em Aparecida. "O passeio está excelente. Mesmo com a chuva, a gente está saindo, fazendo as compras, indo à Basílica", disse.

Santuário Nacional de Aparecida — Foto: Gustavo Marcelino

A rede hoteleira já sente o aumento na procura. Há reservas para os primeiros dias de outubro, incluindo o caso de pessoas que preferem antecipar a visita à cidade ou que não conseguem viajar no dia 12.

Em uma rede de hotéis da cidade, mais de dois terços dos quartos já estavam ocupados para o período da festa.

Segundo o gerente-geral da rede de hotéis, Wanderson Bernardes, a procura tende a aumentar com a proximidade da celebração.

"A partir de julho todos os finais de semanas ficam lotados. Os nossos hotéis têm uma grande procura o ano todo, mas no segundo semestre, em especial nos finais de semana, essa demanda aumenta bastante mesmo", afirma o gerente de hotel Wanderson Bernardes.

Fiéis durante missa na Basílica de Aparecida . — Foto: Reprodução/TV Vanguarda

Além dos romeiros que se programam para a data, há também quem prefira visitar Aparecida fora do período de maior movimento.

Uma família de São Paulo mantém a tradição de visitar a cidade todos os anos em dias antes da Festa da Padroeira , justamente para evitar a maior concentração de turistas.

"Geralmente, a gente vem antes da festa da novena e participa em casa com a imagenzinha, o altarzinho. Desta vez, nós viemos antes, e é uma alegria vir com a família", afirma a comissária de bordo, Daniela Paulino.

Para alguns visitantes, a distância e as condições do tempo também não são obstáculos.

Um grupo que saiu de Cuiabá, no Mato Grosso, onde as temperaturas estavam próximas dos 40°C, chegou a Aparecida para enfrentar o frio e a chuva. A viagem, segundo os visitantes, é motivada pela fé.

"Nós fizemos um proposito de todo ano a gente visitar a casa da mãe. Nós sentimos muito acolhidos aqui, por todos. Neste ano, eu trouxe as minhas primas para vir aqui agradecer à Nossa Senhora. Tudo vale a pena se for para agradecer à mãe", diz a servidora pública Ana Paula de Almeida.

A programação da Festa da Padroeira no Santuário Nacional ocorre entre 3 e 12 de outubro. Neste ano, o tema é “Com Maria, em comunidade, conhecer e praticar a Palavra”.

Além do Santuário Nacional, a movimentação envolve hotéis, restaurantes, lojas de artigos religiosos, comércio e outros serviços ligados ao turismo religioso.

O arcebispo de Aparecida, Dom Mário Antônio — Foto: Thiago Leon/A12

A Novena e Festa da Padroeira começa em 3 de outubro e segue até o Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, em 12 de outubro.

A programação inclui missas, novenas, carreata, procissão, vigília e apresentações musicais.

Em 7 de outubro, haverá uma carreata. No dia 9, está previsto o Festival da Padroeira. A Procissão Memória para a Capela São Geraldo e a Vigília Mariana ocorrem dia 11.

No dia 12, o Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, a programação começa na madrugada e segue durante todo o dia . Entre os principais momentos estão a Missa Solene, às 9h; a Consagração Solene, às 15h, na Basílica Histórica; a Missa de Encerramento, às 18h; e a Procissão Solene, às 19h30, seguida de show pirotécnico.

Movimento no Santuário de Aparecida — Foto: Andressa Lorenzetti/TV Vanguarda

Tema: “Com Maria, a Palavra de Deus nos faz participar da história da salvação!”

08h — Concentração para o Passeio Ciclístico — Tribuna Dom Aloísio Lorscheider

Tema: “Com Maria, praticamos a justiça social como compromisso de amor e de paz!”

articles.title: Kaia Gerber’s RE/DONE Knit Cutout Top Is Barely Hanging on by a Few Ties
articles.summary: Kaia Gerber is once again fronting RE/DONE, and this time, the standout piece is a knit top that’s more open than closed. The model and RE/DONE creative dire...
articles.body:
Kaia Gerber models a daring cutout knit top named the Hurston Knit Top for RE/DONE’s ‘After Hours’ campaign, featuring three functional front ties creating open cutouts from neckline to hem.

The top, made from 100% cotton in a soft black knit with rolled edges, has a slightly relaxed silhouette, three-quarter length sleeves, and a wide crew neckline, styled by Gerber with high-waisted dark denim jeans in a moody, book-lined space.

RE/DONE marks the Hurston Knit Top as ‘coming soon’ in classic black and lighter gray colorways, with sizing from XS to L and care instructions calling for a cold hand wash or dry clean to preserve the knit’s shape, as part of a collection with a literary naming convention.

Kaia Gerber is once again fronting RE/DONE, and this time, the standout piece is a knit top that's more open than closed. The model and RE/DONE creative director stars in the brand's 'Kaia Vol. 1: After Hours' campaign. The setting is a moody, book-lined space that leans heavily into old-money, literary glamour.

Kaia Gerber's RE/DONE knit top comes with risky ties and endless cutouts

Kaia Gerber models daring cutout knit top for RE/DONE's 'After Hours' campaign. The featured piece in question is the Hurston Knit Top . RE/DONE named the garment after acclaimed author Zora Neale Hurston. Made from 100% cotton in a soft black knit, the top features three functional front ties running down the center, creating a row of open cutouts from the neckline to the hem instead of a traditional closure. Rolled edges throughout give the piece a naturally lived-in feel that fits the "after hours" theme of the collection.

The top features an easy, slightly relaxed silhouette that skims the body rather than clinging to it. Three-quarter length sleeves and a wide crew neckline complete the stylish garment. In the campaign images, Gerber wears the top loosely tied, leaving noticeable gaps down the front. She pairs the garment with high-waisted dark denim jeans, balancing covered-up and daring styles in equal measure.

Styling throughout the campaign leans heavily into a bookish, after-hours mood, with Gerber photographed in front of towering bookshelves, sunglasses tucked into the top's ties, and her hair styled in loose, tousled waves. The moody lighting and library backdrop give the images an editorial, almost cinematic quality. This distinct aesthetic fits the collection's literary naming convention.

According to the product listing, RE/DONE marks the Hurston Knit Top as 'coming soon.' The brand offers a classic black option, which RE/DONE lists as 'noir,' alongside a lighter gray colorway. Sizing runs from XS to L, with care instructions calling for a cold hand wash or dry clean to preserve the knit's shape.

The top isn't the only piece from this drop making headlines. Gerber also shared campaign shots of herself wearing an unbuttoned jacket over lace-trimmed underwear. Another featured photo highlights an all-white look with a double-breasted blazer and no pants. Across the campaign, Gerber's dual role as both face and creative director shows in just how deliberately provocative each piece feels.

articles.title: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky welcome their first child together: report
articles.summary: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky have reportedly welcomed their first child together, fulfilling the singer's long-expressed desire for motherhood.
articles.body: Lady Gaga is now a mother, according to multiple reports. People and Page Six confirmed that the 40-year-old singer and her fiancé, Michael Polansky, have welcomed their first child together. No other details have been shared. Fox News Digital has reached out to Lady Gaga for comment. The Grammy Award-winning singer spoke to the New York Times in March 2025 about her desire to be a mother, saying she is "excited to be a mom" although she "used to have a lot of apprehension about it." AUBREY PLAZA CONFIRMS PREGNANCY WITH FIRST CHILD AFTER PERSONAL CHALLENGES AND HEALTH STRUGGLES "I’m also kind of at war with myself sometimes as I get ready to, hopefully, become a mom soon," she said. "Like, today is wonderful, but the whole day has revolved around me. There’s an incredible amount of narcissism in this. How do I live a life where I’m passionate about my art while also making more space for other things?" One of her main concerns about motherhood, she shared, was "to not force my children to live a life that they are not choosing," and to "give them space to discover who they are on their own." She also previously spoke about her excitement about having children during a March 2020 interview with InStyle. "Isn’t it incredible what we can do? We can hold a human inside and grow it," she said. "Then it comes out, and it’s our job to keep it alive." articles.title: Sonu Nigam sells 3,082 sq ft commercial property in Mumbai’s BKC for Rs 18 crore, earns Rs 3.70 crore profit nearly three years after buying it for Rs 14.30 crore
articles.summary: Singer Sonu Nigam has sold a commercial property in Mumbai’s Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) for Rs 18 crore, according to property registration documents .
articles.body: Singer Sonu Nigam has sold a commercial property in Mumbai’s Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) for Rs 18 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix. The singer sold the 3,082 sq ft commercial space nearly three years after purchasing it for Rs 14.30 crore in November 2023.The latest Sonu Nigam property sale adds to the growing list of high-value commercial real estate transactions in Mumbai’s BKC, one of the city’s most sought-after business and financial districts.According to the property registration documents, Sonu Nigam sold the commercial space on September 4, 2026. SAA Estate LLP has been listed as the purchaser, while Sonu Nigam is mentioned as the seller in the registered transaction.The property is located on the ground floor of Trade Centre, opposite the MTNL Building in BKC, Bandra East, Mumbai. The commercial unit has a carpet area of 3,082 sq ft and was sold for a consideration of Rs 18 crore.The transaction also involved a stamp duty payment of Rs 1.08 crore. Two car parking spaces were included as part of the deal, according to the documents.Sonu Nigam earns around Rs 3.70 crore on BKC propertySonu Nigam had purchased the same commercial property for Rs 14.30 crore in November 2023. With the latest sale registered at Rs 18 crore, the singer has made a gross gain of approximately Rs 3.70 crore on the property before accounting for transaction-related costs, taxes and other expenses.Based on the recorded carpet area and the consideration value, the latest transaction works out to approximately Rs 58,404 per sq ft.Kailash Kher also sold BKC office spaceInterestingly, Sonu Nigam is not the only Bollywood or music personality to have recently sold commercial real estate in the same building. Singer Kailash Kher also sold his office space in the building on September 9, 2026, for Rs 10.50 crore.Kher had purchased the property for Rs 10.50 crore in November 2025. Unlike Sonu Nigam’s transaction, the Kailash Kher deal was reportedly executed at the same consideration value at which he had acquired the office space.Sonu Nigam bought an office in Andheri WestInterestingly, Sonu Nigam had also made another commercial real estate investment in Mumbai just a month before the BKC transaction. In August 2026, the Bollywood singer purchased a 258.33 sq ft office space in Mumbai’s Andheri West for Rs 1 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.The transaction was registered on August 6, 2026, with Singular Health Private Limited listed as the seller and Sonu Agamkumar Nigam, the singer’s full name, recorded as the purchaser.The office unit is located in Sundervan Complex on Lokhandwala Road, Andheri West, and has a carpet area of 258.33 sq ft. Nigam paid a total consideration of Rs 1 crore for the commercial property.In addition to the purchase price, the transaction attracted Rs 6 lakh in stamp duty and a registration fee of Rs 30,000. The total disclosed transaction cost, including stamp duty and registration, stood at Rs 1.063 crore.Based on the consideration value, the Andheri West office deal works out to approximately Rs 38,710 per sq ft of carpet area.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: El otoño que se espera en España... y en el Mediterráneo: ojo a lo que ocurrirá en septiembre, octubre y noviembre
articles.standfirst: Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica Mario Picazo
articles.summary: Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica Mario Picazo
articles.body: El verano se va acabando, va dejando rescoldos y el otoño está al acecho. Pero durante los últimos años en España este momento suele aletargarse en el tiempo y asistimos a temperaturas más suaves e incluso calurosas que antaño. Es por ello que Mario Picazo, expertos en el tiempo, ha explicado lo que se está formando con vistas al futuro a corto plazo: “A día de hoy, el Niño se está fortaleciendo en el Pacífico y el escenario merece especial atención”, ha señalado. Los modelos señalan que este fenómeno no solo ha aumentado en exceso las temperaturas durante el verano, sino que además traerá importantes cambios en otoño e invierno. “A día de hoy, el escenario más probable para el otoño es claramente cálido, con un Mediterráneo y Atlántico proporcionando mucha humedad y energía”, apunta. El experto meteorólogo también da detalles de lo que se avecina en una zona en la que hay que mantener la luz de alarma ante lo que puede venir por sorpresa con temporales o DANAs. "El mayor riesgo de episodios de precipitación intensa en el Mediterráneo y Baleares, mientras aumenta progresivamente la posibilidad de entradas atlánticas por el oeste y noroeste”. A todo ello, el cambio de estación oficial llegará el 23 de septiembre y los modelos prevén temperaturas más altas que otros años para los meses de septiembre, octubre y noviembre. Por tanto, Picazo advierte del doble sentido del mismo, ya que la previsión para el otoño de 2026 parece clara. Será “probablemente cálido y con mayor potencial de episodios lluviosos”, indica.

articles.title: Norris takes Madrid pole with 'gorgeous' lap
articles.summary: Lando Norris takes a superb pole position for McLaren at the Spanish Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
articles.body:
Lando Norris took a superb pole position for McLaren at the Spanish Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in a breathless final few seconds of qualifying.

"Oh, what a lap, gorgeous," said an ecstatic Norris after pipping world championship leader Antonelli by just 0.011 seconds. "Oh, that might be my best one."

Verstappen was 0.140secs off the pace, as all three moved ahead of Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari in Madrid.

The seven-time champion had held the top spot after the first runs in the final session.

Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc was fifth, ahead of Mercedes' George Russell and the second McLaren of Oscar Piastri.

Norris' pole came from nowhere. He had been fifth in the first session of qualifying, seventh in the second, and 0.449secs slower than Hamilton's pace-setting lap after the first runs in the final session.

"I'm shocked," the world champion said. "I'm a little bit surprised to be here. It was probably one of the best laps I've done ever in my career.

"One of those laps when everything came together. I had a good idea of what I wanted to do, it was whether it came together but my brain let me do it almost perfect. It's one of those laps when you look at the time and go: 'Oh, that was pretty good."

The session had started with predictions of a crash-fest, after drivers had been warning about the high-risk nature of the new Madring street circuit, with tricky entries to corners and walls coming back at the drivers on the exits.

Two red flags during final practice had led some teams to have private sweepstakes as to how many stoppages there would be in qualifying, but the session ran cleanly, with no incidents.

Pole looked to be a battle between Antonelli and the Ferraris, with Verstappen perhaps in the mix.

In the end, the Ferraris faded, as they so often have this year when it really matters, and Norris rose to the front with a breathtaking performance.

"The adrenaline was high on the last lap," he said. "You have to relax and let it all flow.

"It's easy to get tense around here. There's a lot of walls that come at you pretty quickly. I have been feeling pretty good, I just wasn't relaxed.

"I was pretty much perfect apart from the last corner, where I thought I was in the wall. Everything I wanted to achieve I achieved and it's one of those moments when I was in that flow state."

Hamilton, who had crashed at the final corner in practice and missed the final half of the session, did improve on his last lap, but only by 0.06secs and it was not enough to prevent him falling backwards.

He edged Leclerc by just 0.006secs as Ferrari rued yet another tantalising chance slipping through their fingers.

Norris' performance was put in perspective by Piastri, who was 0.470secs off his team-mate's pace.

Russell, meanwhile, could have done with a morale-boosting performance after he finished second to Antonelli in Monza last weekend when the Italian took a stunning win from 19th on the grid.

The Briton had looked more or less on Antonelli's pace for much of the weekend, even if he clearly lacked the Italian's fluid ability to let the car run free and flow and slide on corner exits.

And in qualifying the difference was a stark 0.314secs, making more likely the prospect of the 66-point gap in the championship between them extending still further on Sunday.

The top 10 was completed by Red Bull's Liam Lawson, Alpine's Franco Colapinto and the Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad, the British rookie again impressing.

Local heroes Carlos Sainz and Fernando Alonso were unable to give the Spanish fans much to cheer about as both were knocked out after the first session in 17th and 18th places.

Sainz's Williams edged out Aston Martin's Alonso by just 0.076secs but faces an investigation into impeding Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas that could result in a three-place grid drop.

10. Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.217
authors: Andrew Benson - F1 Correspondent in Madrid

articles.title: Mackenzie Phillips shocks with 15-year celibacy confession as Sharon Stone, Teri Hatcher rethink romance
articles.summary: Mackenzie Phillips revealed on a podcast that she has been celibate for 15 years, joining Sharon Stone and Teri Hatcher in new Hollywood trend.
articles.body: Mackenzie Phillips revealed that her past extroverted life is nothing like her current status. Phillips, 66, admitted in an upcoming episode of Valerie Bertinelli's "Getting Naked" podcast that her social battery quickly becomes depleted after a busy day. "I would get home, and I would have no words left, you know, and so in order to get up and do it again the next day, I had to be alone to recharge," she said, per People. "Which is, by the way, why — am I going to say this out loud? — I have been celibate for 15 years." 'AMERICAN PIE' STAR SHANNON ELIZABETH SWEARS OFF DATING, SAYS ONLYFANS IS 'THE ONLY RELATIONSHIP I NEED' Bertinelli confided that "there was nothing wrong with being celibate," before Phillips explained that she's "had enough sex to last for several lifetimes for several people." "And the parts of me that were injured or wounded, I can care for them myself," she said before noting that she doesn't date. "I have my little friend in the bedside drawer." Bertinelli admitted that she also experienced "periods of celibacy" and hasn't been physically intimate in "almost two years now." Phillips first married music manager Jeff Sessler for two years before their divorce in 1981. She then married guitarist Shane Fontayne for 14 years before their split in 2000. SHARON STONE ADMITS THE BRUTAL MOMENT SHE KNEW HER MARRIAGE WAS OVER In 2005, the "American Graffiti" actress married her third husband, Keith Levenson, which ended in divorce two years later. Celibacy appeared to be trending in Hollywood this summer as Sharon Stone recently admitted that she, too, chose a path of celibacy. "I'm a really good girlfriend, but I haven't been a girlfriend in a long time," Stone said during an appearance on the "Mayim Bialik's Breakdown" podcast. "And I've been a girlfriend to bad boyfriends, and I've been a girlfriend to good boyfriends." CHRISTIE BRINKLEY SAYS SHE'S RETHINKING SOULMATES AFTER FOUR MARRIAGES "I've had good luck and bad luck and no luck at all," she said. "For quite a long time I’ve had no luck at all. I've been celibate for quite a while now because I'm just at the point where I really only want to be with someone that I care for." While the "Basic Instinct" star revealed her dating patterns, she also noted that she's now looking for "someone that's my companion, not just someone to have sex with." "I'm kind of bored with that," Stone said of casual flings. "I'm in the no luck at all phase right now," before adding that it's "the phase you need to be willing to be in to have the thing that I really want." Bialik asked if Stone had "a great love" of her life. The "Total Recall" star was first married to producer Michael Greenburg for six years before their divorce in 1990. She was then married to journalist Phil Bronstein from 1998 to 2004. "I have had loves in my life, but I don't think I've had the great love of my life," she said. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "Desperate Housewives" actress Teri Hatcher recently confessed that she hasn't been on a date in seven years. Hatcher, 61, told HELLO! that while she would "never say never" to a date, she's absolutely "so single." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "Oh my god, I'm so single. I go through life with an open heart and I would never say never, but I don't date," she confessed earlier this week. "I don't go on dates, I don't look to go on dates. I haven't been on a date in… I don't think I'm exaggerating if I say seven years." Hatcher added, "I have such a giant community of beautiful friends and most of my girlfriends who are my age I've known for at least 30 years, and they're mostly married." While she did briefly date a British man, Hatcher admitted that there "really isn't a new source of people." "Sometimes if I go to a charity event, I'll think, 'Oh, maybe I'll meet a like-minded person that cares about curing cancer,' but I don't," she said. Hatcher sang a similar tune during a 2024 appearance on "The Sherri Show." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "People would say... 'Are you dating?' and I'd say, 'Well, I don't date much anymore because I used to date, and you'd look across the table at the guy... you'd think, 'OK, I wonder if we're going to end up in bed together,'" she said. "Now I look across the table and I just think, 'When am I going to have to change this guy's diapers?' It's just not that fun anymore." Earlier that year, the "Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman" actress admitted she was kicked off a dating app after her profile was flagged for appearing to be fake. "You know, I thought, I'm going to say to the universe that I am open and vulnerable, and I'm putting myself out there," Hatcher explained on "Getting Grilled with Curtis Stone." "That's what I thought my gesture of joining that Hinge app would be. And then they kicked me off." She added, "Well, they thought I was pretending to be Teri Hatcher." "They apologized, and then I was like, 'I'm sort of over it.' So now I'm over it," she continued. "I'm definitely done with the dating apps, and I feel like if there's any way I'll go somewhere and meet someone, that's what it's going to have to be, but honestly, I'm happy." In 1989, Hatcher married personal trainer Marcus Liethold before divorcing one year later. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP She then married Jon Tenney in 1994, and the former couple welcomed a daughter in 1997. By 2003, though, the pair called it quits.

articles.title: Carmen Alcayde confiesa las secuelas de su "horrible" salto en 'Supervivientes': "Es más alto de lo que parece y me dolió la espalda"
articles.standfirst: La valenciana ha hablado sobre ello en ‘El verano se mueve’, de Telecinco
articles.summary: La valenciana ha hablado sobre ello en ‘El verano se mueve’, de Telecinco
articles.body: Aprovechando el reciente inicio de la nueva edición de ‘Supervivientes All Stars’, Carmen Alcayde ha rememorado su paso por el espacio de supervivencia, calificando el emblemático momento del salto desde el helicóptero como uno de los más estresantes de su concurso. Durante su intervención en ‘El verano se mueve’, el programa de Telecinco que presenta Ion Aramendi por las tardes de lunes a viernes, la periodista y colaboradora se sinceró sobre el verdadero impacto físico y mental que supone enfrentarse a las alturas en el reality de Honduras. "Fue horrible. Es lo peor junto con la lluvia. Es más alto de lo que parece", comenzaba diciendo. La valenciana confesó que llegó a pedir que le bajaran la aeronave “como a la Pantoja” y que el helicóptero está "mucho más alto de lo que parece" en televisión. Para ella, el miedo y la tensión de ese salto se sitúan en el escalafón más alto de los aspectos más duros del formato, llegando a afirmar que es "lo peor del programa junto con la lluvia". Aunque en su momento (durante la edición de ‘Supervivientes 2025’) intentó tomárselo con humor e incluso pidió que el helicóptero bajase al máximo para no quedar mal ante la audiencia, la colaboradora reconoce ahora que la procesión iba por dentro y el impacto emocional fue real. Finalmente, Alcayde no dudó en aplaudir a los concursantes de esta nueva edición que han reconocido la angustia que se siente desde arriba, especialmente a Asraf Beno, el marido de Isa Pantoja. “Olé, él, para que los hombres tienen que ser los valientes y las mujeres las cobardes", ha sentenciado. Cabe recordar que Carmen Alcayde dejó un buen sabor de boca durante su etapa en los Cayos Cochinos, destacando por sus alianzas y tensiones en las nominaciones. Tras enfrentarse a varias expulsiones y un paso por la zona de destierro, fue finalmente la novena expulsada de la edición en un ajustado duelo contra José Carlos Montoya.

articles.title: Oscar-winning film producer Jeremy Thomas dies aged 77
articles.summary: Best known for The Last Emperor and Sexy Beast, the British film-maker was celebrated for working with international directors throughout his decades-long career.
articles.body:
Oscar-winning producer Jeremy Thomas, whose films included The Last Emperor and Sexy Beast, has died aged 77.

The British filmmaker "passed away peacefully" surrounded by family and loved ones at his home in Oxfordshire on Friday, his publicist said in a statement.

Thomas built an international reputation over a career spanning five decades, working with directors including David Cronenberg, Nagisa Oshima, Julien Temple and Nicolas Roeg and backing independent films alongside mainstream successes.

He best known work, Bernardo Bertolucci's The Last Emperor, won nine Academy Awards, including best picture, and earned Thomas an Oscar as producer in 1988.

The critically-acclaimed biographical drama about the final monarch of China's Qing dynasty starred Joan Chen, Peter O'Toole and Vivian Wu.

Thomas repeatedly collaborated with Bertolucci, also producing The Sheltering Sky, Little Buddha, Stealing Beauty and The Dreamers.

He also collaborated with several British directors at the start of their careers including Ben Wheatley, Jonathan Glazer, Stephen Frears and David Mackenzie.

Thomas's other credits include Oshima's Merry Christmas, Mr Lawrence, starring David Bowie, Cronenberg's A Dangerous Method, Roeg's Bad Timing and Eureka, Fast Food Nation, The Great Rock 'n' Roll Swindle, and the film adaptations of the JG Ballard books Crash and High-Rise.

After beginning as a film editor, London-based Thomas landed his first production role on the 1976 Australian film Mad Dog Morgan.

In 2006 he received the European Film Academy's award for Outstanding European Achievement in World Cinema and in 2009 was made a CBE in the New Year Honours.

Thomas's latest collaboration with Japanese director Takashi Miike, Bad Lieutenant:Tokyo, is due to premiere at the Toronto Film Festival on Monday.

articles.title: Sylvan Esso think you should splurge on good-quality yogurt
articles.summary: Sylvan Esso’s new organic-sounding record Ow ∞ is out now.
articles.body: Amelia Meath and Nick Sanborn, better known as Sylvan Esso, have been bringing their low-key electro-pop to the masses since 2014, bursting onto the scene with their self-titled debut album and the single “Hey Mami.” Over the years, they’ve put out a number of excellent records, dabbling in dustier, more fragile textures on Free Love, going dancier and glitchier on No Rules Sandy. The two are constantly pushing at the edges of their sound while retaining the core of what makes a Sylvan Esso record sound like a Sylvan Esso record. Their new album Ow ∞, released this past Friday, represents perhaps the boldest reinvention of their sound, however. It’s unabashedly nostalgic-sounding, trading the glitchy modular drums and glossy dance production of Free Love for turn-of-the-century breakbeats and distorted guitars. At times, the songs recall bands like Soul Coughing and Blur, on tracks like “Hot Slob” and “Concrete Glen.” But don’t worry, there’s still plenty of bleeps and bloops and modern vocal production techniques to keep fans of past albums happy. [Media: To celebrate the release of Ow ∞ , Sylvan Esso agreed to answer our weekly questionnaire. What is your most indispensable tool? Nick Sanborn: My laptop. I have loved a series of MacBooks dating back to when I graduated from high school and cannot imagine working without one. I am absolutely one of those millennials who despises typing or doing any important work on a touchscreen. What is one thing you wish you could change about your phone? NS: I wish it felt like it cared more about me than its creator. Amelia Meath: I wish the phone was actually a food replicator. So many problems would be solved. How many tabs do you have open right now? NS: Eight, which feels a touch low compared to my normal ADHD tab expanse. No pins besides email, though, I like a tabula rasa scene when I open a browser. What is your happy place online? NS: I still frequent a version of the old Monome forum, which is generally focused on programming and instrument design. The people there are excellent and interesting and so welcoming and nice. It’s the only place on the internet that feels more positive than detrimental to me. AM: Spellsofmagic.com. What is your favorite gadget you’ve ever owned? AM: I had a T-Mobile Sidekick that I saved up for when I was in high school. It was the coolest phone I have ever owned. I kept my journal on there :D What game do you have the fondest memories of? NS: EarthBound, which was a gorgeous, heartfelt, quirky JRPG on the Super Nintendo that came out in 94. It’s beautiful and strange and full of humanity. I still play it all the way through every few years. AM: The first Zelda I played was Skyward Sword on the Wii. We lived in a house with a whole bunch of other people, and we would all hang and play together. It was a joy and became my gateway into playing games as an adult. There have been so many others that I have fallen in love with since then — Hollow Knight, Blue Prince, Hades — but Skyward Sword was my first love. So much lore. Which tech trend do you wish would go away? AM: The encouragement of apathy. What is one thing you wish you had created? NS: I rarely wish I had made something that I already like, since I feel like me making it would have ruined it being what it is in the first place. But I have been dreaming about a really specific thing — an AM/FM radio with an analog tuner that I could control remotely with a computer or sequencer — for literal years. There are many things out there that are close but not quite this, so much so that it’s kinda maddening. I even tried to get a synth tech I work with regularly to help me prototype one, but it never came to fruition. Finally, last year, a small company in Italy started making one, and like four friends sent me the link in a week, that was how endlessly chatty I had been about wanting one. Of course I ordered one, and it’s good, but I still think it could be better lol. AM: I wish I had the well. What an incredible claim to fame. “I figured out how to store and save water from the table.” I feel like I could stop trying after that. What do you do when you need to focus? AM: I go outside and sit. Usually, I have to be writing, so I can take my notebook out. I try to leave my phone inside, but I usually forget! What do you do when you’re feeling stuck? NS: I usually find myself stuck when I want something to be good and it just isn’t yet, but I can’t let it go. In that situation, I just have to step away and do something totally different and without consequence, like pulling out an instrument I haven’t used in a while and making something unrelated as spontaneously as I can. I find removing expectations and shifting gears to be really helpful for my headspace when I can’t find a way through whatever has me in a loop. When was the last time you went somewhere without your phone? NS: About a month ago, I put my phone through both the washer and dryer, destroying it completely and giving me about a week of pure phoneless existence. It was heaven. Highly recommend. What’s the last piece of physical media you bought? AM: I just bought Sheila Heti’s Pure Colour at a bookstand in Brooklyn. It is a beautiful and incredibly surreal read. What do you think is worth splurging on? NS: Yogurt. It’s not even that much of a splurge, but I just think good yogurt is utterly transcendent. Deeply underrated delicacy. What would the tagline for your biopic be? AM & NS: “Ow ∞” What’s the last GIF or meme you used? [Image: AM: This is also the last GIF I used!!!

articles.title: Judge Judy preparing to end decades-long run as TV's toughest judge
articles.summary: Judge Judy Sheindlin reveals she's retiring from TV after "Judy Justice" ends in October, but her next move keeps her in the entertainment world.
articles.body: Judge Judy Sheindlin is planning to hang up her robe for good. "Judge Judy is passing the gavel to her son, Adam Levy, in ‘Adam’s Law,'the courtroom program she created and is an executive producer," a rep for Sheindlin told Fox News Digital. "It premieres in national syndication this Monday, Sept. 14." "She is not retiring, just rewiring." During a recent interview with People, the 83-year-old judge and television personality shared that she plans on retiring from TV after her Prime Video series, "Judy Justice," comes to an end in October. "I have a lot of other things of interest," she said. "I don’t want to do hair and makeup anymore, but I still want my message to get out there." ROSIE O'DONNELL WALKED AWAY AT THE HEIGHT OF HER SUCCESS AFTER REACHING ONE JAW-DROPPING FINANCIAL MILESTONE Her son, Levy, graduated from New York’s Hofstra Law School, and after taking a detour working as a ski instructor, he worked in private practice and as the Putnam County, N.Y. District Attorney, before starting his own journey in television in 2023 on the Prime Video show "Tribunal Justice." "There aren’t a lot of people who can carry a half hour on their own unscripted," Sheindlin said. "He has what it takes." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Scheindlin graduated from New York Law School in 1965 and worked as a prosecutor, handling juvenile crime, domestic violence and child-abuse cases, starting in 1972. After retiring from family court, she launched the popular syndicated show "Judge Judy," which aired for 25 seasons, from 1996 to 2021. At its peak, the show reached an estimated 10 million viewers, and Scheindlin became known for her no-nonsense attitude and classic one-liners. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "So many of the emails and letters I get are from women who watched me and had their daughters watch me," she told the LA Times in June 2021 about the impact of the show. "They told me the show helped them take the next step, whether it was getting a divorce, leaving an abusive person, asking for a raise and never, ever becoming somebody’s prisoner." During an interview with Fox News Digital in November 2022, Scheindlin's granddaughter, Sarah Rose, shared what her grandmother taught her, noting she does in fact have a soft side despite her TV persona. She shared that the best piece of advice Scheindlin has given her is that "you have to define yourself, and you tell other people who you are. Not the other way around." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "[She taught me] not to let anybody else define you but yourself," Sarah Rose said. "You have to have a good feeling about yourself and be confident in yourself. And, really, if you have that as a foundation, the opportunities are endless for where your journey might lead. I’ve always taken that to heart. No matter what anyone else’s opinions, feelings or thoughts are, I just know that I’m secure in myself. And she’s playing a big role in that." While Sara Rose admits Scheindlin could be a "no-nonsense grandmother," she also has "a much softer, supportive side," noting she is often "the first person I call if I have a problem or a question or something that needs to get solved." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "She’s a fantastic problem solver, especially for the ones that she loves," she added.

articles.title: Moreira adapting to Milan and Gila saw ‘honestly disastrous’ first half
articles.summary: Diego Moreira admits he needed a little more time to adapt to Serie A and Milan after scoring twice against Lazio, but Mario Gila confessed their ‘first half...
articles.body:
Diego Moreira admits he needed a little more time to adapt to Serie A and Milan after scoring twice against Lazio , but Mario Gila confessed their 'first half was honestly disastrous.'

This was a truly chaotic encounter at the Stadio Olimpico, as Lazio had been leading comfortably 2-0 at the break thanks to goals from Matteo Cancellieri and Tijjani Noslin .

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Nuno Tavares of SS Lazio competes for the ball with Ruben Loftus-Cheek of AC Milan during the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)

The Rossoneri made a triple substitution for the second half, and it paid off, as Diego Moreira scored twice in 120 seconds to level the result.

Christian Pulisic also impressed on his season debut after a microfracture at the World Cup, with his fellow USMNT player Yunus Musah also making an impact.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Diego Moreira of AC Milan scores the team's second goal during the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)

"I am very happy for my first two goals, I would've been happier with a winner. I think it was a great second half and we could've done more," Moreira told DAZN Italia.

This was the first brace of his entire club career, and so an even more remarkable achievement in his second appearance.

Moreira was poor in his debut against Juventus , and seemed almost too shy to attack, but that was on the right flank and today was in the left, so did that affect his confidence?

"I wouldn't say I was shy, it was an introduction to the Italian League against a big team. I was on the left today, it's the same for me both sides, so we'll see the next game where I will play."

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Diego Moreira of AC Milan celebrates after scoring the team's first goal during the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)

This is the second consecutive draw for Milan in Serie A, but while they had been in front against Juventus and saw Federico Gatti snatch an equaliser, it felt like a get out of jail free card to claw back from 2-0 down with Lazio.

"In the first half we were honestly disastrous. We were not the Milan that we want to be," Gila told DAZN Italia.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Mattia Zaccagni of SS Lazio competes for the ball with Mario Gila of AC Milan during the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Marco Rosi – SS Lazio/Getty Images)

"It was different in the second half, we realised who we are and what we want to do. I think we deserved more than a point for that second half, but we must work to avoid the first half happening again.

"We lost the ball too often in the first half, but when we're strong on the ball, I believe we can be one of the best teams in the league. When you are not in good shape and lose duels, anyone can cause you problems."

images.caption: Moreira adapting to Milan and Gila saw 'honestly disastrous' first half
